title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：weekday　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weekday 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the teacher ① kept the weekday that no pupil in the classroom would have described, and he said the keeping was the whole of the term. The ② weekday, meaning the day itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a weekday, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ weekday in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ weekday at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A weekday, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the weekday was the whole of the matter, meaning the routine and not the day. The ⑥ weekday, meaning the routine and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; weekday, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a day and a routine. He said the routine is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ weekday had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ weekday of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of describing; weekday, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ weekday I remember is the day described in the notebook, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ weekday, my mother said in 1997, is the only day that improves by being described; every weekday, she said, is a routine that has agreed to look like a day. She said the routine was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工作日（指教室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 工作日（指那个工作日本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the weekday 守这一个工作日
D. n. 工作日（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 工作日之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的工作日之事）
F. n. 工作日（指笔记簿里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 工作日、常课（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 常课（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the weekday that no pupil in the classroom would have described
The weekday, meaning the day itself and not the ruler
the weekday at the far blackboard

answers.why: keep the weekday 意为“守这一个工作日”，1988 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯描述的一个工作日做了一遍。
weekday 意为“工作日”，指那个工作日本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
weekday 意为“工作日”，指教室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
weekday 意为“工作日”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
weekday 意为“工作日、常课”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个常课就是那件事的全部。
weekday 意为“常课”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个工作日，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
weekday 意为“工作日”，指笔记簿里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1993 年这一个成了笔记簿里的一行。
weekday 意为“工作日之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的工作日之事是一处教室和三个学期的描述。
weekday 意为“工作日”，我记得的是笔记簿里描述过的那一个，1995 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一个。
weekday 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，工作日是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的工作日。
